model_annotation: The graph displays the performance comparison of two network types—intermediate network (A2, B1, C1) and random network (A1, B2, C2)—across four semantic categories (A1, B1, C1, C2) labeled on the x-axis. The y-axis represents a numerical metric ranging from 3.0 to 5.5, with a linear scale and increments of 0.5. The intermediate network (red line with arrow markers) shows a decreasing trend from 3.254 at A1 to 3.179 at B1, then increases to 3.235 at C1, and finally decreases to 3.685 at C2. The random network (blue line with star markers) starts at 4.189 at A1, decreases to 4.030 at B2, then increases to 4.265 at C1, and ends at 5.204 at C2. Both lines exhibit fluctuations across the categories, with the random network consistently showing higher values than the intermediate network across all data points.
